title: —Ma! Almidano Artifoni said.
html_source: Almidano Artifoni, apparently an Italian music teacher, is a fictional character, named after the owner of the language schools in Pola & Trieste, where Joyce taught in 1904/5. He says “Ma!” [“But!”] & his statement is continued after the reference to the two carfuls of tourists.
